description: Effective env/agent configuration of the full D2-MARL model in the CityFlow runs of the paper (6 traffic files x seeds 10/100/1000; Jinan: retraining with the unified waiting-time limits 60/90/60 s), in the naming of this release. Options that were disabled in the paper and are not part of this release (spillback guard and a zero-weight reward term) and the run label are omitted. tests/test_config_equivalence.py checks that run_d2marl.py with the flags of README.md reproduces these configurations.
